tasks.name: reject-refresh-account-switch
tasks.summary: Added a cookie-mode UUID guard for refresh and explicit session restore. When an existing account differs from the response account, the local session generation is invalidated and pending requests stop; the shared cookie is preserved. Added regression tests for mutation retry prevention, concurrent requests, explicit restore, anonymous initialization, and same-account refresh. `npm --prefix front run typecheck`, `npm --prefix front run test` (102 passed), and `npm --prefix front run export` passed. Browser verification remains unavailable.
